entities.summary: Thinh Xuan Nguyen (b. 1973-01-03, Ho Chi Minh City) was a entrepreneur or business leader of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ho Chi Minh City and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, religious figures, oceania.
